Code Velocity

Overview

CG

《Code Velocity》is a cute chibi-style casual competitive typing game. Players can play as cops or thieves, with movement speed determined by their typing speed and accuracy. In real-time matchups, use props, compete for vehicles, and experience intense chase showdowns!
